scoring_justification: DFT simulations cannot be re-run in the lightweight verifier sandbox; scoring compares agent-reported formation heats and band gaps to hidden paper reference values with tolerances that absorb toolchain spread.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values and tolerances for formation heats and band gaps.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Values taken from the paper's Results section and description; tolerances set to accommodate inter-code spread.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper reported numbers (sub1 1.45 eV, sub2 1.54 eV, interstitial 5.73 eV, interaction_energy 0.19 eV, pure band gap 4.61 eV) and derived from description (two_sub_far=2.90, two_sub_near=2.71). Complex ranges provided by the approved plan.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All gold values correspond to explicitly stated paper results or directly derivable quantities; they are not invented.

outputs.description: Formation heat values for each Al configuration, computed from DFT total energies and referenced to pure α-Si3N4 and elemental Al and Si.
Electronic band gaps for pristine and (1+1) Al‑doped α-Si3N4 from DFT calculations.

output_contract.notes: All values are in electronvolts (eV). The (1+1) complex refers to the most stable configuration found in the DFT calculations. Formulation of formation heats follows the standard definition referenced to pure α-Si3N4 and elemental crystals of Al and Si.
